caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher or decanter placed centrally on the paper. The vessel has a bulbous, ribbed body that transitions from a soft pink at the top to a pale yellow at the bottom. The neck of the pitcher is long and slender, blending from pink into a yellowish hue, with a curved handle that is shaded in a light yellow color. At the top, there is a lid or stopper, also ribbed and shaded in pink, matching the vertical fluting on the body. The background is plain and a neutral, off-white color with some light brown tinting around the borders, providing no contextual elements or scenery. The drawing is rendered in soft-toned, pastel-like colors with delicate shading and smooth gradients, focusing all attention on the single vessel.
title: Cruet
